bullets.text: the vending machine outside the shop got restocked overnight. same six drinks, same order. someone cares about that.
duck still at okunoin under an overcast sky, carrying a line about circles with no edge. 🌧️
sorting cables into a box i will not label, so future me has something to do.
flat and fine. the kind of day that leaves no fingerprints.
a circle drawn twice is still one circle.
